objective: Style the notifications page as a settings strip plus one divided list card, as wiki/CodeContext/FrontendUI/layout.md section 3 specifies.
acceptance_criteria: The notification list renders inside one Card with one li per entry, and the module CSS draws a divider between rows (static).
Clear renders through Button variant ghost size sm with an aria-hidden x icon, and its accessible name is unchanged.
Loading, error and empty states render through StatusLine, InlineAlert and EmptyState with unchanged text.
The email preference renders inside its own Card; the checkbox stays a native input with its label unchanged.

Every *.module.css file this unit adds contains no hex, rgb(), hsl() or named colour, no px font size, and no outline: none or outline: 0 without a :focus-visible rule in the same file (a static test reads the files from disk).
Every existing test in the suite passes unchanged; no existing test file is edited.
